channel.title: CIS 525 - Introduction to Network Programming :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description Basic inter-process communication and network programming concepts including client-server and peer-to-peer, communication protocol use and specification, reliable and secure communication, and network applications including web technologies, electronic mail, and file transfer with a focus on application and implementation. Credit Hours 3 credits Course Overview Not yet drafted — pending course-designer’s detailed pass. resources/reference/degree-maps/cs.md lists this as one of three choices (with CIS 520, CIS 625) for the Year 4 Systems Elective, which “fulfils ABET networking and OS requirements; may become a regular tech elective instead.”
